definitions: A fictional continent and setting for much of J.R.R. Tolkien's fantasy writings, including The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.
In Norse mythology, the human-inhabited world, situated between Asgard (the realm of the gods) and Niflheim (the realm of the dead).
examples: Many adventures take place in Middle-earth.
The hobbits rarely left the Shire in Middle-earth.
Middle-earth is a rich and detailed world.
